services.name: Input_SelectPrimaryPatternTable
services.behavior: Stores the primary controller-pattern table address 0x00004128 in INPUT_PATTERN_CURSOR and INPUT_PATTERN_MIRROR_CURSOR, then clears INPUT_PATTERN_MATCH_LATCH.

services.name: Input_SelectAlternatePatternTable
services.behavior: Stores the alternate controller-pattern table address 0x0000413A in INPUT_PATTERN_CURSOR and INPUT_PATTERN_MIRROR_CURSOR, then clears INPUT_PATTERN_MATCH_LATCH.

context.table_format: Two-byte controller samples terminated by FF 00; the consuming services compare the sampled controller nibbles against the active table and advance by two bytes when a match is latched.

conclusion: The ROM has two explicit controller-pattern table selectors. Their table contents and callers are recorded while the higher-level purpose of each pattern remains intentionally unnamed.
